title: pulsatilla violacea subsp. armena
intro: Pulsatilla violacea subsp. armena, commonly known as Armenian Pasque Flower, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating menstrual disorders, menopausal symptoms, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Pulsatilla violacea subsp. armena include its emmenagogic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
